item.title: Napa native named new chief wine judge for California State Fair
item.description: Tim McDonald is the new chief judge of the California State Fair Commercial Wine Competition. He is the founder of Napa-based Wine & Spirits Spoken Here.

item.title: New leadership for Kaiser Permanente’s Golden Gate Service Area
item.description: Abhishek Dosi has been named senior vice president and area manager for Kaiser Permanente's Golden Gate Service Area, including San Rafael Medical Center.

item.title: The best St. John’s wort supplement for mood support
item.description: St. John’s wort is a medicinal herb that has been used for years as a natural alternative in treating mild depression and anxiety.

item.title: Add antioxidants with the best maqui berry supplement
item.description: Maqui berries are a fruit native to South America. The fruit, leaves and stem have been used medicinally for centuries for its variety of health benefits.

item.title: Sonoma evacuation study flags chokepoints, shapes future growth and safety plans
item.description: City Council looked at a recent evacuation study of Sonoma's roadways during its Feb. 4 session. City administrators, along with police and fire officials, reviewed the area's potential chokepoints, as well as the sites in need of improvements. They also considered how the city's evacuation routes will impact future development and fire safety.

item.title: Sonoma Botanical Garden adds to leadership team
item.description: Sonoma Botanical Garden has added to its leadership team, moves aimed at strengthening the organization’s internal infrastructure during a time of growth.

item.title: Sonoma Valley Unified board to vote on contract with new superintendent
item.description: Possible approval of a contract of more than three years between the Sonoma Valley Unified School District and incoming Superintendent Jason Sutter is among the agenda items for the district’s board of trustees meeting on Thursday, Feb. 12.

item.description: Anne Moller-Racke, co-owner and winemaker of Sonoma’s Blue Farm Wines — a leader in making Pinot Noir — will share grapevine selection tips during a free talk on Thursday, Feb. 12, as part of the monthly public education series by the nonprofit Sonoma Home Winemakers.
